excluded.POST /runs/{run_id}/chat: LLM: the Run Assistant answers through a model (out of the non-LLM target)
excluded.POST /runs/{run_id}/chat/confirm: LLM-driven: confirms an action the Run Assistant proposed
excluded.GET /runs/{run_id}/stream: SSE stream held open for minutes; not a request/response latency
excluded.POST /webhooks/telegram: Telegram's callback, authenticated by the webhook secret; same decision path as the mock press (HIL-1 measured it in-process)
excluded.POST /mock-outbox/{message_id}/press: needs the notify worker's Telegram-mock messages; the web decision is the measured decision path
excluded.POST /templates/drafts/{draft_id}/publis: lifecycle action: each sample would publish a new template version
excluded.POST /templates/{key}/versions/{version}: lifecycle action: would archive the seeded template
excluded.GET /evals/runs/{run_id}: no eval run exists in the seeded org (`GET /evals/runs` is measured, empty)
excluded.POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel: terminal: each sample would need a fresh run
excluded.POST /runs/{run_id}/tasks/{task_id}/retr: needs a failed task; the stub executor does not fail
excluded.POST /runs/{run_id}/tasks/{task_id}/comp: needs a failed task; the stub executor does not fail
